review_evidence: This 1,771-file HOL unit is entirely under examples/ and spans machine-code models, logic, algebra, formal languages, computability, lambda calculus, crypto, separation logic, theorem-prover examples and many other object-level formal developments.

Directory naming alone was not used to filter `examples`, `dev`, `tests` or demo scripts; the unit is retained because these files contain actual theory scripts, definitions and theorem statements valuable as prior art.
summary: Reviewed the large HOL examples unit and retained all 1,771 primary files; it is formal example/theory content rather than distribution tooling.
